Selected outside sources

Editorial starting points, not a ranking.

  • The Poker Bank: organized hold'em strategy library

    Greg Walker / The Poker Bank · Free · Article collection

    A topic-organized archive covering position, betting, mathematics and cash-game concepts, with named contributors.

    Before you use it: Some material is historical and the site carries gambling promotions. Review assumptions and publication dates; inclusion does not endorse its operator promotions or profit claims.

    Public page read · 2026-10-08 · Full listing

  • PokerStars cash-game rake schedules

    PokerStars · Free · Official rules

    An operator's public explanation and tables for cash-game rake and caps.

    Before you use it: Rates vary with game, stakes, players and region. This is not a live-cardroom fee table; consult the applicable current terms rather than copying a rate into another game.

    Public page read · 2026-10-08 · Full listing

  • Crush Live Poker videos

    Crush Live Poker · Mixed · Video library

    A video catalogue covering live hold'em, Omaha, split-pot games, and hand analysis.

    Before you use it: Much of the library needs a membership; free-labelled material can have access conditions.

    Public page read · 2026-10-07 · Full listing
